correctness.rationale: Using \(\mathbb F_4=\mathbb F_2(\omega)\) with \(\omega^2=\omega+1\), independent exact division gives remainders \(1+\omega^2x+\omega x^3\) for the listed-order polynomial and \(\omega+\omega x+\omega^2x^2+\omega^2x^3\) for the reverse ordering. Both are nonzero, contradicting the defining generator divisibility condition for an \(\omega\)-constacyclic code. As a separate check, the six unwrapped shifts have rank six, minimum distance three, Hermitian Gram rank six and hull dimension zero, with the stored weight distribution reproduced exactly.

value.rationale: The error affects a published optimal-code row and its advertised entanglement-assisted quantum-code application. Identifying the exact divisibility failure, removing coefficient-order ambiguity and quantifying the direct shift-span mismatch is a substantive reproducibility correction.

final_claim: The first quaternary row of Debnath--Islam--Yadav--Prakash Table 2 is not \(\omega\)-constacyclic as printed: neither coefficient ordering of \((1,\omega,1,1,1)\) divides \(x^{10}-\omega\) over \(\mathbb F_4\), so that printed generator does not certify the advertised \([10,6,4]_4\) code, hull dimension two, or \([[10,4,4;2]]_4\) application.
limitations: This diagnoses the first Table 2 row as printed; it does not rule out a typographical correction or another code with the advertised parameters.
The auxiliary ordinary shift-span calculation is only a consistency check and is not proposed as the intended replacement constacyclic code.
